channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio considera mudar correção da Previdência, da saúde e da educação para obter até R$ 250 bi
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's economic team is studying a fiscal measures package to contain mandatory spending and enable an initial adjustment of around 2% of GDP, equivalent to approximately 250 billion reais. Among the considered measures are changes in the correction of Social Security, health, and education.

item.title: Vida selvagem na América Latina despenca 95% desde 1970, alerta WWF
item.description: Latin America and the Caribbean lost 95% of vertebrate biodiversity between 1970 and 2022, according to WWF's Living Planet 2026 report, with agriculture and ecosystem conversion as the main drivers. Brazil stands out with interventions like the Soy Moratorium, but the decline severely impacts amphibians, fish, mammals, birds, and reptiles.

item.title: Brasileirão: confira os melhores momentos dessa quarta-feira (7/10)
item.description: The 29th round of the Brazilian Championship took place on Wednesday (10/7) with wins for Cruzeiro, Vasco, Bragantino and Vitória, plus draws between Corinthians x Remo, Grêmio x Mirassol, and parallel news on politics and security. The competition continues with excitement in the relegation battle and the race for the top.

item.title: Melhores campanhas do returno, Santos e Flamengo jogam pelo Brasileirão
item.description: Santos and Flamengo face off in the 29th round of the Brazilian Championship with identical second-half campaigns. The match takes place at 7:30 PM at Vila Belmiro, featuring a showdown between top scorers Pedro and Gabigol.

item.title: Times da Série A usam patrocínios pontuais no lugar de bets
item.description: On Wednesday (7), the first round of the Brazilian Championship after the ban on sports betting advertisements, in effect since MP 1.394/2026, did not feature betting sponsors on team jerseys. Teams like Internacional, Corinthians and Remo replaced betting brands with temporary or institutional sponsors, while others such as Bragantino and Mirassol kept previous partnerships.

item.title: Datafolha divulga primeira pesquisa presidencial do 2º turno nesta quinta-feira (8)
item.description: Datafolha releases its first presidential poll for the second round between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) following a tight first-round result. The survey interviews 2,520 voters between October 6-8, with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Em 2 cidades, Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula tiveram o exato mesmo número de votos para presidente no 1º turno
item.description: In the 2026 Brazilian presidential election first round, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) tied with exactly 679 votes in Crixás do Tocantins and 575 votes in Trabiju (SP). The race proved extremely close, with the narrowest historical margin of 1.87 percentage points, setting up a runoff on October 25th.

item.title: Lula perde terreno nas cidades pequenas, enquanto Flávio Bolsonaro avança no interior
item.description: In the 2026 municipal elections, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) lost electoral leadership especially in cities with up to 10,000 inhabitants, while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) advanced in the countryside. Of the 579 municipalities that no longer have Lula as leader, 365 are small cities, representing 63% of the total, according to first-round data. The president's decline was sharper in the South and small towns, maintaining stable performance only in large urban centers.

item.title: TSE deve julgar nesta quinta desistência de recurso de Garotinho e definir eleição para o governo do RJ
item.description: The TSE will rule on whether Garotinho can withdraw his appeal against ineligibility, potentially electing Ruas in the first round. The decision impacts the possibility of a runoff between Ruas and Paes.

item.title: Após citar desorganização, Lula coloca petistas do Nordeste no comando da campanha
item.description: Lula announced the inclusion of three Northeastern politicians in the second-round campaign coordination to reverse underperformance and contain Flávio Bolsonaro's lead. Camilo Santana, Rui Costa and Rafael Fonteles will assume distinct roles amid internal criticism over disorganization and focus on legacy rather than everyday issues.

item.title: Mãe vai à Justiça após vídeo do filho com arma em ato do PL, diz jornal
item.description: The mother of a child who appeared holding a firearm-like object during a pro-Flavio Bolsonaro rally in Parnamirim (RN) has filed a lawsuit against the father, alleging child endangerment. The case is under investigation by child protection agencies and monitored by the Public Ministry. Although the father claims the object was a toy, laws prohibit displaying weapon replicas in risky situations.

item.title: “Flávio quer mudar a Constituição” tem aumento de buscas no Google
item.description: Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated plans to amend the Constitution via PEC to reform the judiciary, reduce the age of criminal responsibility, and end reelection, prompting a surge in Google searches exceeding 900%. The statements followed meetings with party leaders supporting his campaign for the second round. PEC approval requires two voting rounds in the Chamber with 308 favorable votes each.

item.title: ‘Caminho do precipício’, diz autor de pedido de impeachment de Dilma ao criticar Flávio
item.description: Miguel Reale Jr. criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential bid, calling it a 'path to the precipice' due to support for coup plotters and alignment with the U.S. government. He endorses Lula as an alternative to protect democracy and national sovereignty.

item.title: “Ser contra o split payment é beneficiar fraudadores”, diz Durigan
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan defended the split payment mechanism in the tax reform, stating that opposing it benefits fraudsters. He emphasized that the model will bring transparency and fight fake invoices. The proposal to eliminate the mechanism was made by Flávio Bolsonaro's advisors, who consider it harmful to small businesses.

item.title: Fã-clubes de artistas pop se mobilizam para reforçar presença de Lula nas redes sociais
item.description: Pop artist fan clubs mobilize around 20 million followers to boost Lula's social media presence, sharing campaign content and creating their own materials like videos and edits. The initiative emerged spontaneously, focusing on minority rights and culture, and was publicly acknowledged by Lula via an audio message thanking fans. This strategy is part of a broader digital effort by the campaign to engage younger voters in the election runoff.

item.title: Coordenador da campanha de Lula admite erro e avisa: ‘Amanhã sai pesquisa, não esperem coisa boa’
item.description: Gilberto Carvalho, Lula's campaign coordinator, acknowledged mistakes in the first round strategy and warned that upcoming polls may show a larger gap, but urged supporters not to panic. He highlighted changes in the candidate's communication style and admitted failures regarding financial education and public dissatisfaction. The focus will now shift to future plans and building a win in the runoff.

item.title: Nova pesquisa medirá Flávio x Lula no estado onde senador teve mais que o dobro de votos
item.description: A new Quaest survey will measure the race between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the Acre presidential runoff, after Bolsonaro secured 64.56% of the vote against Lula’s 28.73% in the first round. The poll, released on October 13, will examine voting intentions, firmness of choices, and perceptions of the matchup.

item.title: Papa Leão 14 pede que Nossa Senhora Aparecida proteja brasileiros
item.description: Pope Leo XIV asked Our Lady of Aparecida to protect Brazilians during a Vatican audience, ahead of the October 12 celebrations. The mention comes after a fake news involving presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro and an archived 2008 bill questioning the title of patron saint of Brazil.

item.title: Ala do MDB cobra apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro, mas Baleia Rossi resiste
item.description: Regional leaders of the Brazilian Democratic Movement (MDB) are pressuring party president Baleia Rossi to endorse Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who has so far refused. The push aims to align the MDB with other parties that have already supported Flávio, such as União Brasil, PP, and Republicanos. Rossi's stance could influence the 2026 electoral strategy.

item.title: Moraes manda intimar Bolsonaro em caso das joias sauditas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, responding to a Federal Revenue request, summoned former President Jair Bolsonaro to address a tax violation charge related to the Saudi jewels he received during his term. The jewels were seized and transferred to a Federal Revenue office in Guarulhos for assessment of forfeiture, to be integrated into the Union's property if the process concludes that way. The Public Ministry of the Republic highlighted the lack of clear legislation regarding the ownership of gifts received by presidents during official missions.

item.title: Moody’s vê corte de gastos sob Flávio Bolsonaro, mas aponta falta de detalhes e riscos no Congresso
item.description: Moody's projects that a Flávio Bolsonaro administration would implement significant spending cuts and reduce public debt, but notes a lack of concrete details and political hurdles in Congress. Public debt exceeds 82% of GDP with structural budget constraints amid high interest costs.

item.title: Lula, el PT y sus aliados se lanzan a la batalla final en redes ante una derecha que domina en internet
item.description: Following the far-right's victory in the 2nd round election, Lula and the PT must redefine their digital strategy for the October 25th race, as their online campaign failed to balance misinformation combat and voter engagement. The strong presence of the right on the internet and WhatsApp's dominance as the main electoral communication channel demand a new approach.

item.title: Kassio libera propagandas da campanha de Flávio que associam Lula a Moraes, caso INSS e cassinos ilegais
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques rejected requests to remove campaign advertisements from Flávio Bolsonaro's team that link Lula to Moraes, the INSS case, illegal casinos, and public debt. The ruling favored Flávio's campaign, deeming the materials compliant with electoral guidelines. The PT sought to censor the posts, but the TSE denied their appeal.

item.title: Moraes leva caso de Eustáquio a julgamento; defesa diz haver revelia
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes ordered the edital notification of journalist Oswaldo Eustáquio, accused of criminal association in post-2022 election acts, and forwarded the case to the 1st Panel of the STF for virtual plenary judgment. The defense alleges hearsay, arguing that Eustáquio has had a fixed address in Spain since 2023, known to the STF, and that the edital notification violates the right to defense, as the lawyer was not served the indictment or summoned.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: a primeira pesquisa Quaest em um estado do Nordeste no segundo turno
item.description: A new Quaest poll will be released in Rio Grande do Norte examining voter intentions for the runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The survey will use spontaneous and prompted formats, measuring vote firmness and evaluating other state races. Lula leads significantly in the state with 59.75% in the first round.

item.title: ‘O problema fiscal não será resolvido com corte de gastos’, diz cotado a ministro de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Marcelo Kayath, a potential Finance Minister under Flávio Bolsonaro, says spending cuts are only temporary and won’t solve Brazil’s fiscal deficit. He criticizes Lula’s policies for raising public debt, forcing the Central Bank to keep interest rates high and discouraging productive investments. Kayath argues that sustained economic growth of 3-4% annually is key to a lasting fiscal solution.

item.title: A estratégia de Flávio e o dilema de Lula no segundo turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign enters the second round with a strategic advantage in building alliances, according to political scientist Daniela Alves. While the left concentrated forces behind Lula, right-wing candidacies were fragmented, allowing Flávio to expand his base. Parties such as União Brasil, PP, Republicanos, and Novo have already declared support for the senator.

item.title: PCB e PSTU farão 'apoio crítico' a Lula e ao PT no segundo turno
item.description: Left-wing parties PSTU and PCB declared critical support for Lula da Silva (PT) in the second round. The stance reflects a strategy of left-wing alignment while maintaining criticism of the previous government. This support aims to consolidate the progressive base for the election.

item.title: ‘Discutiram de dar o golpe’, admite presidente do PL sobre governo Bolsonaro
item.description: The president of PL, Valdemar da Costa Neto, admitted in an interview that members of the Bolsonaro government considered carrying out a coup in 2022, but stated that planning a coup should not be a crime. He also avoided ruling out a new attempt under a potential Flávio Bolsonaro government.

item.title: ‘Em breve falarei’, diz Augusto Cury sobre apoio no segundo turno
item.description: Former presidential candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) posted a video on social media stating he will soon make a public statement about his support in the second round of the 2026 elections. He explained that he chose silence after the first round to listen and reflect before making a wise decision. Cury emphasized issues such as education, health, protection of children and women, and national pacification, asking for patience from followers and voters.

item.title: Republicanos vê resistência do PL a Motta na presidência da Câmara
item.description: The PL party's bancada in the Chamber shows resistance to President Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), according to national leader Marcos Pereira. During an event formalizing support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round, Pereira clarified that the tension comes from the PL's elected base, not Flávio. He emphasized dialogue as the solution, noting Flávio's conciliatory profile. Motta, who supports Lula, did not attend the announcement, and the party may respect local exceptions like Paraíba and Pernambuco.

item.title: Valdemar admite que houve plano de golpe no fim do governo Bolsonaro
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the Brazilian Republican Party (PL), acknowledged publicly that there was a coup d'état plan at the end of Bolsonaro's government but stressed such an action would be unacceptable under a potential Flávio Bolsonaro administration. He also advocated for pardons for those involved in the January 8th riots and downplayed the severity of the coup planning.

item.title: UNE mobiliza estudantes no Rio por reeleição de Lula
item.description: Students from public schools and universities in Rio de Janeiro held a protest on Wednesday, 7, supporting Lula's (PT) re-election. The event, organized by UNE and secondary school entities, marched from Igreja da Candelária to Cinelândia, gathering participants advocating for educational and social policies.

item.title: PoderData registra nova pesquisa sobre Lula x Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: PoderData will release a new poll on voter intention for the second round between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), based on 3,000 interviews with a margin of error of 1.8 percentage points. The election is set for October 25, and the latest poll showed a technical tie between the candidates.

item.title: Marinho manifesta “preocupação” com reunião entre Moraes e diretor da PF
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho expressed concern over a meeting between Minister Alexandre de Moraes and Federal Police Director-General André Rodrigues, calling for transparency regarding the encounter.

item.title: Lula ou Flávio? Márcia Sensitiva fez previsão para o 2º turno das eleições
item.description: Medium Márcia Sensitiva told the Brazilian media outlet Metrópoles she does not see a chance of Lula's reelection and suggested mapping his political future. In the first round of the 2026 elections, Flávio Bolsonaro led by 1.87 percentage points over Lula, securing a spot in the runoff.

item.title: Reale Junior declara voto em Lula e critica Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lawyer Miguel Reale Junior, who authored the impeachment request against Dilma Rousseff, announced his vote for Lula in the second round and criticized Flávio Bolsonaro. In an open letter on Instagram, he warned of the risks of a 'dictatorship' with the PL candidate.

item.title: ‘Sou contra um Posto Ipiranga na Fazenda’, diz cotado para ser ministro de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Marcelo Kayath, mentioned as a potentialFinance Minister for Flávio Bolsonaro, opposes the idea of a 'super-ministry' or 'Posto Ipiranga', advocating collaborative governance. He stresses clear communication and political negotiation, but claims he never discussed positions with Flávio.

item.title: PSDB apoiará Flávio no segundo turno?
item.description: The national president of PSDB, Aécio Neves, stated that the party awaits statements from state directories to decide whether to support Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round or remain neutral, with the decision expected next week.

item.title: Cleitinho confirma apoio a Flávio no 2° turno em evento do Republicanos
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo, elected governor of Minas Gerais, confirmed support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential runoff during a Republicanos event in Brasília. Together with Tarcísio de Freitas and other party leaders, he reinforced the decision after a period of neutrality in the first round.

item.title: Lula fala em novo lema no 2º turno: 'Para o povo trabalhador, proteção; para bandido, a prisão'
item.description: President Lula adopted a new campaign slogan for the second round, emphasizing protection for workers and action against crime. He hardened the public security discourse, aiming to reorganize his political group after the first round.

item.title: Por virada, ministros de Lula montam força-tarefa e se revezam em entregas
item.description: Lula's ministers are organizing a task force to ensure key public works are delivered before the October 25 runoff vote, rotating responsibilities across cabinets. The strategy aims to recover from a weaker-than-expected first-round showing and expand outreach to centrist and right-leaning voters.

item.title: TSE julga caso Deltan Dallagnol nesta quinta-feira (8) após votação que o coloca no Senado
item.description: The TSE will rule on Thursday (8) on the case of Deltan Dallagnol, former 'Operation Car Wash' prosecutor who secured 2.9 million votes and a Senate seat from Paraná. The decision may affect his standing in the state's Senate delegation.

item.title: Estudantes fazem ato no Rio de Janeiro em defesa de voto em Lula
item.description: Students held a pro-Lula rally in Rio de Janeiro demanding public education funding, democracy, and social rights. The incumbent president seeks a second term against Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 runoff. The demonstration highlighted criticisms of the prior administration and warnings about constitutional threats.

item.title: Augusto Cury critica 'guerra de ódios' e promete se pronunciar em breve: 'Por favor, aguardem'
item.description: Writer Augusto Cury, candidate for president by Avante, criticized the 'war of hatred' in the 2026 elections and promised to speak soon, without officially supporting any candidate in the runoff. He received 2.89% of valid votes, placing third behind Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula.

item.title: Republicanos declara apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Republicanos party declared support for senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential election runoff, following a meeting between party leaders and Flávio. The announcement strengthens the coalition backing the PL candidate against President Lula.

item.title: O risco do cheque em branco: os limites da euforia com os resultados da eleição estão na política
item.description: The article examines the risks of euphoria regarding potential election outcomes, noting that a candidate's victory will not resolve structural challenges such as the fiscal crisis, strained relations between powers, and the lack of a reform agenda. Despite expectations of change, the economy faces external and internal obstacles, requiring consensus beyond the ballot box.

item.title: Com Moraes impedido, STF rejeita recurso que tentava libertar Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court rejected 3-0 a habeas corpus seeking to free Jair Bolsonaro, sentenced to 27 years for leading a coup plot. Justice Carmen Lúcia denied the motion and the appeal, stating the petition was unauthorized by the former president. Justice Alexandre de Moraes recused himself from the case.

item.title: Ato por reeleição de Lula organizado pela UNE leva estudantes às ruas do Rio
item.description: High school and university students organized by UNE held a march in Rio de Janeiro supporting Lula's reelection, advocating for free and expanded public schools, continuation of the Pé-de-Meia program, and protection of educational budget.

item.title: Lobista amiga de Lulinha diz que “já já a Kátia Abreu será rifada”
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Fábio Luis Lula da Silva (Lulinha), publicly criticized former senator Kátia Abreu after she confirmed criticizing Janja's role in Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaign. In an Instagram post, Luchsinger suggested Abreu will be 'kicked out' soon, intensifying the controversy over differing positions within the federal government.
